verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~37% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~16% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 90 vs sector median 37; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 34, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
